candidate.selection_reason: user-controlled src parameter -> Function constructor execution -> arbitrary code execution vulnerability
candidate.source_summary: src parameter passed directly to the exported function; no validation of content before execution
candidate.sink_summary: Function constructor executes JavaScript code from src string parameter
candidate.guard_summary: Only catches SyntaxError; no validation, sanitization, or security controls on src content
candidate.risk_pattern: Untrusted input passed directly to Function constructor without validation, allowing arbitrary code execution
enclosing_conditions: try-catch block only catches SyntaxError, not security exceptions
candidate.context_summary: Module exports a function that takes src parameter and executes it via Function constructor; only syntax errors are caught, allowing arbitrary code execution for valid JavaScript
unresolved_facts: How the module is called/imported by other code
Whether src parameter comes from user input or trusted sources
